reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open of Chronicle's live Apollo ACRDX Proof of Asset dashboard (slug anemoy-tokenized-apollo-acrdx; legacy proofofassets URL 404s) on 2026-07-28 reports Portfolio Holdings of USD 42,247,796 Apollo Diversified Credit-I Fund shares (dashboard label typo: Difersified), USD 1,188,950 cash, and USD 70,838.76 cryptocurrency, totaling USD 43,507,585 gross holdings. Two-decimal weights via largest-remainder on those gross values are 97.11%, 2.73%, and 0.16% (sum 100); the dominant reserve is the disclosed Apollo fund share rather than look-through private credit. The same dashboard reports NAV USD 43,468,112, share price USD 1.019554, and 42,634,425 outstanding shares. Independent on-chain corroboration: Ethereum Blockscout logs for Chronicle VAO consumer 0x9a3bF392...D7488 show Poked val 1019554312938520000 (USD 1.01955431293852 per share) and matching UPoked proofURI through 2026-07-27T23:03:23Z, reconciling to the dashboard share price. Anemoy and Centrifuge launch disclosures independently state ACRDX is a feeder providing tokenized access to Apollo Diversified Credit Fund. Gross holdings exceed reported NAV by about USD 39,473; the dashboard does not explain that residual. Cash counterparties and the cryptocurrency token remain undisclosed. Holdings document dataDate in Chronicle metadata is 2026-07-24; oracle verification timestamp used for compositionAsOf is 2026-07-27.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle-verified gross feeder-fund holdings, reconciled to ACRDX NAV, share price, and on-chain Chronicle VAO Poked value
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Chronicle labels USD 70,838.76, or 0.16% of gross holdings, only as cryptocurrency; it does not identify the token. Cash counterparties, the look-through obligor schedule inside the Apollo fund share, and the ~USD 39,473 gross-holdings-to-NAV difference are also unexplained, while the feeder-level asset categories and weights are reported.

mintAuthority.summary: ACRDX is a permissioned NAV-accreting fund share issued by Anemoy via Centrifuge rails; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated at fund NAV. On Ethereum, the Centrifuge ShareToken is warded by a Root contract (0x7ed4...368f), a Spoke contract (0xec35...25ab), and a BalanceSheet (0x12a1...43e); the Root is governed by a Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian (0xceb7...35c6) backed by a 4/9 Safe multisig (0x9711...7d225). On Plume and Monad, the same Spoke is the sole ward (Root not deployed separately on those chains — consistent with Centrifuge cross-chain architecture).

controls.label: Anemoy / Centrifuge fund issuance authority
controls.evidence: Permissioned fund-share issuance: Anemoy (through Centrifuge) mints ACRDX against KYC-gated NAV subscriptions and burns on redemption; transfers are restricted to whitelisted holders. No permissionless mint route.

controls.label: ACRDX Centrifuge Spoke ward (direct mint path — Ethereum, Plume, Monad)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, wards(0xec3582...) on the ACRDX ShareToken (0x9477...4a74f) returned 1. At Plume block 74211635, wards(0xec3582...) on the Plume ShareToken (0x9477...4a74f) returned 1. At Monad block 80740709, wards(0xec3582...) on the Monad ShareToken (0x2fabf1...3245) returned 1 and eth_getCode confirmed the Spoke is deployed there. Blockscout identifies this as the Centrifuge Spoke contract — the on-chain contract that calls mint()/burn() for cross-chain subscriptions/redemptions.

controls.label: ACRDX Ethereum/Plume Root ward (protocol admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, wards(0x7ed48c31...) on the ACRDX ShareToken returned 1. At Plume block 74211635, wards(0x7ed48c31...) on the Plume ShareToken also returned 1. Blockscout identifies this as the Centrifuge Root contract. Root controls the rely/deny of all wards on the token. Note: Root ward returns 0 on Monad (0x2fabf1...3245) — Monad deployment uses Spoke-only ward architecture; the Spoke itself is the sole warded contract there.

controls.label: Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian Safe (Root authority)
controls.evidence: The Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian (0xceb7...35c6) has a safe() function that returns 0x9711730060c73ee7fcfe1890e8a0993858a7d225. This Safe is a 4/9 Gnosis Safe v1.4.1 (masterCopy slot 0 = 0x41675c09...). getOwners() returned 9 addresses; threshold (slot 4) = 4; getModulesPaginated returned empty modules; guard (slot 6) = 0. ProtocolGuardian is warded on Root (wards(0xceb7...) = 1 at block 25295029).

review.evidence: Anemoy/Centrifuge materials describe a permissioned, NAV-accreting fund-share token. Ethereum confirmed at block 25295029: ShareToken wards = Root (0x7ed4), Spoke (0xec35), BalanceSheet (0x12a1); Root governed by ProtocolGuardian (0xceb7) which holds a 4/9 Gnosis Safe v1.4.1 (0x9711...7d225, no modules, no guard). Plume confirmed at block 74211635 (rpc.plume.org): wards(Spoke) = 1, wards(Root) = 1 on ShareToken 0x9477...4a74f. Monad confirmed at block 80740709 (rpc.monad.xyz): wards(Spoke) = 1 on ShareToken 0x2fabf1...3245; Root ward = 0 on Monad (Monad uses Spoke-only ward layout, consistent with Centrifuge cross-chain architecture where Root may not be deployed per spoke chain). Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Chronicle Proof of Asset continuously verifies ACRDX asset and NAV data from the fund administrator. The BVI FSC registry matches Anemoy Capital SPC Limited, the exact current professional-fund issuer.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ACRDX uses Centrifuge V3's native burn-and-mint share bridge over external messaging. The protocol burns shares through the source-chain Spoke before hub-authorized destination minting; the reviewed inventory covers Ethereum, Base, Plume, Monad, Optimism, and Solana.
